<subject>Annual Component Sales Coordination 2022</subject>
<body>
Dear Team,

My name is Laura Mitchell and I am the Sales Coordinator for the Midlands Division this year at Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd. I understand that you managed component sales for your units last year. However, I have not yet received confirmation of the sales managers for your units this year.

Could you please reply to this message to confirm if you are the sales manager for your unit this year? If you are not, I would appreciate it if you could provide the name and contact details of the current sales manager, along with your unit number(s), if known.

I have already reached out to several unit managers today and would like to ensure that the relevant information reaches your unit’s sales manager promptly.

Thank you very much for your assistance.

Kind regards,  
Laura Mitchell  
Sales Coordinator, Midlands Division  
Kestrel Aerospace Components Ltd  
Email: laura.mitchell@kestrelaero.co.uk  
Phone: +44 121 555 7890  
</body>
